units.source_text: 那时候，与其说我是无忧无虑，不如说是百无聊赖。

en.t: At that time, rather than being carefree, I was simply bored to distraction.

units.source_text: 因此，第二天，在估摸着有可能遇到先生的时间，我又特意去了那家茶屋。

en.t: So the next day, at about the time when I thought I might meet Sensei, I deliberately went to that teahouse again.

units.source_text: 没有见到那个洋人，只有先生一个人戴着草帽来了。

en.t: The foreigner did not appear; only Sensei came, wearing a straw hat.

units.source_text: 他摘下眼镜，放在台子上，用毛巾包好头，就立刻下海去了。

en.t: He took off his glasses, set them on the stand, wrapped his head in a towel, and immediately went down into the sea.

units.source_text: 当他像前一天那样，穿过喧闹的人群，一个人游向远处时，

en.t: When, as on the previous day, he passed through the noisy crowd and swam away alone into the distance,
I suddenly wanted to follow after him.

units.source_text: 于是，我一直跑到海水溅到脸那么深的地方后，

en.t: So I ran out until the water was deep enough to splash up into my face,

units.source_text: 朝着先生挥动胳膊，游了起来。

en.t: then began swimming, striking out with my arms toward Sensei.

units.source_text: 可是和前一天不同，先生从意想不到的方向，游了一条弧线回到岸边。

en.t: But unlike the day before, Sensei swam back toward the shore in an arc from an unexpected direction.
As a result, my plan came to nothing.

units.source_text: 我上了岸，甩着滴水的手走进茶屋时，

en.t: When I came ashore and walked into the teahouse, shaking the water from my dripping hands,

units.source_text: 先生已经穿戴整齐，与我擦肩而过，走了出去。

en.t: Sensei was already fully dressed, and he passed by me on his way out.
